rules.label: Close to budget cap
rules.fires_when: Fee burn is 90% or more and % complete is under 80%
rules.next_step: Agree re-phasing or a budget change with the account director

rules.label: Spend over revised SOW
rules.fires_when: Committed spend (fee + OOP + open POs) exceeds the revised SOW
rules.next_step: Confirm an approved scope change, or move the time to the right project

rules.label: Billable time with no rate
rules.fires_when: Billable hours were booked at a $0 rate
rules.next_step: Ask the ERP admin to fix the contract rate, then re-rate the entries

rules.label: In the ERP, not in a tracker
rules.fires_when: A live project has spend but no row in its client tracker
rules.next_step: Add the job to the tracker, or mark it out of scope

rules.label: Revised SOW differs from ERP budget
rules.fires_when: Tracker revised SOW and ERP budget differ by more than $1 and more than 1%, and the project is not done
rules.next_step: Load the approved budget in the ERP, or correct the tracker

rules.label: Implausible ERP budget
rules.fires_when: ERP budget is more than 10x the tracker SOW, or more than $10M on one project
rules.next_step: Raise with the finance manager; likely a keying error

rules.label: Closed project still moving
rules.fires_when: Project is closed or complete but has unapproved time or open POs
rules.next_step: Clear the open items, or reopen the project

rules.label: Unapproved time older than 7 days
rules.fires_when: Time is submitted or returned and older than 7 days at the extract date

rules.label: % complete went down
rules.fires_when: % complete is lower than last month, which reverses revenue
rules.next_step: Record the reason before month-end sign-off

rules.label: OOP billable differs from actual
rules.fires_when: Billable and actual OOP amounts differ by more than $0.01
rules.next_step: Review the markup or pass-through rule

rules.label: Billed ahead of delivery
rules.fires_when: Billing to date exceeds actuals by more than 5% and more than $100
rules.next_step: Threshold pending: Finance to set the rule per contract type
